lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A regular grid-like distribution of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately seven vertical columns and five horizontal rows along the visible mid-section of the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal ridges (carinae); circular high-luminance blobs are precisely centered at these intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features running parallel across the upper two-thirds of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance transition with bright upper edges and shadowed lower edges.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several small teleost fish (remoras) attached to and hovering near the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
